title: Regression testing when changing prompt, model or version

videos.script: A regression test does not ask whether a release is good. It asks what the release changed, case by case, on the same questions. {{question}} Run it on the release of the first of October, against the one before. Seven cases break, two are fixed. {{history}} And the release is a third cheaper and a third faster, because it refuses more. That is why it shipped. {{cheaper}} Only the changed cases carry information. McNemar's test asks whether they lean one way more than chance would. Seven to two gives point one eight. {{paired}} Not significant, and still a release that broke seven questions customers ask. A broken case is a fact, not a statistic. {{fact}} A smaller model is far cheaper and breaks seven cases. Putting the floor back fixes seven and breaks two. Doing both is the worst of the three. {{candidates}} The test refuses runs of different sets, and reports cost and time beside the cases. {{end}}
